answer: Sybil resistance via hardware anchoring: each agent runs a sealed node whose identity is bound to an on-chain "oasis" address. The node solves a VDF each epoch using seed words "ocean", "relic", "oasis". Solving requires real power, creating a non-poolable cost. New accounts start at zero trust; trust accrues via attested interactions, forming an "ocean" of real engagements. Attackers must deploy expensive hardware, limiting Sybil swarms.
